workspace_scope: A global sender has work in A and B. Actual bearer HTTP pages with limit1 preserve all A entries, counters and prefilter inventory after B is introduced; B exposes only B work and unrelated global operator identity does not become a participant.
passive_reads: Two repeated HTTP snapshots plus every group expansion and exact supported target preserve byte-canonical contents of18 execution/session/grant/message/handoff/decision/receipt/setup tables; setup-test cache remains empty. Existing authentication usage metadata is outside this no-productive-effect claim.
limits: Canonical HTTP/SQLite with deterministic own admitted fixture; not native/provider execution or a real remote topology.
Not a claim that every HTTP handler in the repository is side-effect free.
